// Generated by morphrpc-compiler. Payloads use contract schema version 1.
const MAX_PAYLOAD: usize = morphrpc::protocol::MAX_FRAME_LEN - 12;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum PayloadError { TooLarge, Truncated, InvalidBoolean, InvalidUtf8, TrailingBytes }

#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum RpcError {
    Payload(PayloadError),
    Transport(morphrpc::runtime::Error),
    Remote(Vec<u8>),
    UnexpectedResponse,
}

impl std::fmt::Display for PayloadError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result { write!(f, "{self:?}") }
}
impl std::error::Error for PayloadError {}
impl std::fmt::Display for RpcError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result { write!(f, "{self:?}") }
}
impl std::error::Error for RpcError {}

#[allow(dead_code)]
fn append(output: &mut Vec<u8>, value: &[u8]) -> Result<(), PayloadError> {
    if value.len() > MAX_PAYLOAD - output.len() { return Err(PayloadError::TooLarge); }
    output.extend_from_slice(value);
    Ok(())
}
#[allow(dead_code)]
fn append_blob(output: &mut Vec<u8>, value: &[u8]) -> Result<(), PayloadError> {
    let len = u32::try_from(value.len()).map_err(|_| PayloadError::TooLarge)?;
    append(output, &len.to_be_bytes())?;
    append(output, value)
}
struct Reader<'a> { input: &'a [u8], offset: usize }
#[allow(dead_code)]
impl<'a> Reader<'a> {
    fn take(&mut self, len: usize) -> Result<&'a [u8], PayloadError> {
        let end = self.offset.checked_add(len).ok_or(PayloadError::TooLarge)?;
        let value = self.input.get(self.offset..end).ok_or(PayloadError::Truncated)?;
        self.offset = end;
        Ok(value)
    }
    fn blob(&mut self) -> Result<&'a [u8], PayloadError> {
        let len = u32::from_be_bytes(self.take(4)?.try_into().unwrap());
        let len = usize::try_from(len).map_err(|_| PayloadError::TooLarge)?;
        if len > MAX_PAYLOAD { return Err(PayloadError::TooLarge); }
        self.take(len)
    }
}
